verdict.rationale: All MCP evidence describes Supabase acting as an MCP *server* that external AI agents (Cursor, Claude, etc.) connect to and pull tools from, not Supabase itself acting as an MCP client that plugs in and consumes other MCP servers' tools. The dashboard AI Assistant is described as a fixed built-in feature with no documented ability to connect to arbitrary external MCP servers. Missing for 10: any documentation of Supabase (its Assistant, Edge Functions runtime, or CLI) acting as an MCP client that can add/consume third-party MCP servers' tools.
